title: Backspace String Compare
description: Compare two strings s and t after processing '#' as backspaces.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize pointer i at s.length-1, j at t.length-1
2. While i >= 0 or j >= 0
3. Find next valid character for s and t
4. If characters at i and j don't match, return false
5. Decrement pointers and repeat
6. Return true

steps.note: Initialize pointers at the end of strings 'ab#c' and 'ad#c'.
Comparing s[3]='c' and t[3]='c'. They match.
Processing backspace: skip 'b' in s and 'd' in t.
Comparing s[0]='a' and t[0]='a'. They match.

fullDescription:
Given two strings s and t, return true if they are equal when both are typed into empty text editors. '#' means a backspace character.

Note that after backspacing an empty text, the text will continue empty.

 

Example 1:

Input: s = "ab#c", t = "ad#c"
Output: true
Explanation: Both s and t become "ac".

Example 2:

Input: s = "ab##", t = "c#d#"
Output: true
Explanation: Both s and t become "".

Example 3:

Input: s = "a#c", t = "b"
Output: false
Explanation: s becomes "c" while t becomes "b".

 

Constraints:

  • 1 <= s.length, t.length <= 200
  • s and t only contain lowercase letters and '#' characters.

 

Follow up: Can you solve it in O(n) time and O(1) space?
